summary: Frontend-only verification of KP Studio marketing homepage redesign. All specified data-testid selectors work, hero headline renders ('Real strength. / Built to last.'), nav anchors scroll, testimonial carousel cycles all 5 unique quotes and wraps around (prev/next verified), all 6 program-enquire buttons link to #contact, lead form POSTs to /api/leads (200 OK), success toast displays and fields clear, footer login link points to /admin/login and Mo Studio credit links to mozeid.com. No JS console errors on the homepage. The two 401 responses observed are from an admin/auth session-check endpoint and are unrelated to the marketing homepage.
critical_code_review_comments: Home.jsx is ~400 lines and mixes data (programs/testimonials/aboutYou/different arrays) with JSX; consider extracting these to a data module and splitting each section (Hero, About, Programs, Testimonials, Contact) into its own component for maintainability.
The testimonial arrows use ` -1 + length ) % length ` which is fine, but consider adding keyboard/arrow key support and auto-advance with pause-on-hover for better UX.

Two background 401 responses appear from an admin auth-check call fired on the public marketing route; consider gating that call behind the /admin/* route to keep the browser console clean for public visitors.
test_credentials: Not required for marketing page. /app/memory/test_credentials.md not read (no auth flow tested).
seed_data_creation: None. One TEST_ lead was created via lead form (test.playwright@example.com).
